NARRATOR.say: in a deep, slow, ominous Telugu documentary narrator voice, natural Tenglish

KL_ATC.label: KUALA LUMPUR RADAR
KL_ATC.say: calmly and routinely, like an air traffic controller with a Malaysian English accent

PILOT.label: MH370 COCKPIT
PILOT.say: casually and quietly, like an airline pilot signing off at night

CALL.label: ATC · DRAMATIZED

FINAL.label: UNKNOWN · DRAMATIZED

lines.text: March 8th, 2014... Malaysia నుంచి Beijing కి వెళ్తున్న Flight MH370...
lines.sub: March 8th, 2014... Malaysia nunchi Beijing ki velthunna Flight MH370...

lines.text: 239 మంది aboard... అందరికీ ఇది ఒక normal journey...
lines.sub: 239 mandi aboard... Andariki idi oka normal journey...

lines.text: Malaysian three seven zero, contact Ho Chi Minh one two zero decimal nine. Good night.
lines.sub: Malaysian Three Seven Zero, contact Ho Chi Minh one two zero decimal nine. Good night.

lines.text: Good night. Malaysian three seven zero.
lines.sub: Good night. Malaysian Three Seven Zero.

lines.text: కానీ... ఆ goodbye... వాళ్ళ last confirmed radio transmission గా మారింది.
lines.sub: Kaani... aa goodbye... vaalla last confirmed radio transmission ga maarindi.

lines.text: రెండు నిమిషాలు కూడా కాకముందే... radar screen మీద aircraft disappear అయింది...
lines.sub: Rendu nimishaalu kooda kaakamunde... radar screen meeda aircraft disappear ayindi...
